scenes.text: How does an order service get its payment gateway?
scenes.phonemes: hˌaʊ dˈʌz ɐn ˈɔːɹdɚ sˈɜːvɪs ɡɛt ɪts pˈeɪmənt ɡˈeɪtweɪ?

scenes.text: Require a payment gateway in the constructor, and keep its reference in a final field.
scenes.phonemes: ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚɹ ɐ pˈeɪmənt ɡˈeɪtweɪ ɪnðə kənstɹˈʌktɚ, ænd kˈiːp ɪts ɹˈɛfɹəns ɪn ɐ fˈaɪnəl fˈiːld.

scenes.text: Boot scans the components. One gateway bean matches that interface type.
scenes.phonemes: bˈuːt skˈænz ðə kəmpˈoʊnənts. wˈʌn ɡˈeɪtweɪ bˈiːn mˈætʃᵻz ðæt ˈɪntɚfˌeɪs tˈaɪp.

scenes.text: Spring passes it into the service constructor before the application places an order.
scenes.phonemes: spɹˈɪŋ pˈæsᵻz ɪɾ ˌɪntʊ ðə sˈɜːvɪs kənstɹˈʌktɚ bᵻfˌɔːɹ ðɪ ˌæplɪkˈeɪʃən plˈeɪsᵻz ɐn ˈɔːɹdɚ.

scenes.text: Our Boot test confirms the same bean. A fake gateway passes a separate service test.
scenes.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ bˈuːt tˈɛst kənfˈɜːmz ðə sˈeɪm bˈiːn. ɐ fˈeɪk ɡˈeɪtweɪ pˈæsᵻz ɐ sˈɛpɹət sˈɜːvɪs tˈɛst.

scenes.text: Require, resolve, inject, then use. Constructor injection makes required dependencies explicit.
scenes.phonemes: ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚ, ɹᵻzˈɑːlv, ɪndʒˈɛkt, ðˈɛn jˈuːz. kənstɹˈʌktɚɹ ɪndʒˈɛkʃən mˌeɪks ɹᵻkwˈaɪɚd dᵻpˈɛndənsiz ɛksplˈɪsɪt.
